evals.prompt: In an existing Frappe UI 1.x app using createListResource, show how to render loading/error, reload after changing filters, and update the status of a selected ToDo. Keep the existing API.
evals.expected_output: Uses nested list state, update then reload, and awaited setValue.submit.
assertions: Reads nested list loading and error state
Uses awaited setValue.submit with selected row name

evals.prompt: In a standalone Frappe UI 1.x app, give the official links for chart States, Stepper, ThemeSwitcher, and parked ListView. Explain what to import for a new stable list and how to focus and select existing input text when opening a rename dialog.
evals.expected_output: Gives the four exact documentation URLs, distinguishes stable List from parked ListView, and uses v-focus:autoselect.
assertions: Locates all four official documentation pages
Distinguishes stable List from parked ListView
